**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prevent category-list version reuse**

Exact string equality is unsafe unless version values are globally unique or immutable. If revisions move from `v1` to `v2` and later reuse `v1`, evidence from the original list becomes indistinguishable from evidence for the newly activated list, allowing old pull requests and precision runs to satisfy AC15's current-version gates. Require every revision to use a never-before-used version, or key evidence to an immutable revision/content identity rather than the reusable display string.
